vb_textbox.text: Initially start with the lighter coloured gnomes, once the yield begins to decrease switch to the darker coloured gnomes, the baskets colour will change depending on which gnome is selected (yellow and red) although this will take some time to build associations between which gnome provides you with which basket, try to avoid sticking to one set of gnomes or baskets, you will notice as the amount of mushrooms decreases with one approach, it's probably time to switch up, try and ensure that your gnome selection is varied and attempt to figure out which gnomes use which basket so you don't get stuck with repeated low yields, I did notice the pink gnome to be particularly rewarding but eventually will provide you with little to no mushrooms, best of luck!
